numbering_direction.summary: Section numbers INCREASE from left field, around the third-base side, past home plate, along the first-base side, and out to right field. In other words, low numbers = left field / third base, high numbers = first base / right field. This holds on every level: 100 level runs 101 (LF corner) -> 122-126 (home plate) -> 146 (RF corner); the 400 level runs 401-406 (LF bleachers) -> 411-419 (3B side mezzanine) -> ~424 (home plate) -> 437 (RF side); the 500 level runs 509-519 (3B side) -> 523 (home plate) -> 537 (1B/RF side).

accessibility.summary: Great American Ball Park is described by the Reds as a fully accessible facility. Wheelchair-accessible and companion seating is located in the LAST ROWS of sections across essentially every price level - specifically the Infield Box, Field Box, Terrace Line, Terrace Outfield, Mezzanine, Outer Mezzanine, and View Level Box categories. Practically, that means the top row of the relevant 100-level, 400-level Mezzanine (411-419), and 400-level View Level Box (420-437) sections. The top accessible row of each section has electrical outlets available for use. Suite-level seating includes two removable seats at the top row for wheelchairs/scooters. Individual sections also designate a specific accessible row - for example, Row H is the handicap row in Scout Seats section 23. Guests needing wheelchair transport can request it from any Reds Public Safety employee; staff escort guests to their seats.
landmarks: Seven public elevators, located behind sections 101, 110, 121, 127, and 135
Two escalators: one at Gapper's Alley (Terrace Level to View Level) and one at the First Star Fan Zone (Terrace Level to Club Level)

discovery.row_seat_conventions: ROWS ARE LETTERS, not numbers. Lower-bowl infield sections run A-Z and then continue AA-GG (e.g. section 113 is A-Z, AA-GG; section 119 starts at F because rows A-E are consumed by the Dugout Box in-front blocks). Diamond Club sections 1-5 use A-I; Scout Seats 22-25 use A-H; Club Home 220-228 use only A-C; Champions Club 301-307 use A-O; Mezzanine 411-419 use A-R; View Level Box sections have only about six rows; Kroger Bleachers 401-406 use A-Y with the entrance at Row D; Sun/Moon Deck 146 uses A-G with the entrance at Row G. SEAT NUMBERING RULE: facing the field, SEAT 1 IS THE RIGHT-MOST SEAT and seat numbers increase toward the LEFT. This is stated consistently on RateYourSeats section pages ('lower number seats are on the right' / 'the right-most seat when facing the field is seat 1'). Seat counts per row vary within a section (e.g. section 23: rows A-B have 10 seats, C-F have 11, G has 12, H has 9). CONFIRMED: https://www.rateyourseats.com/great-american-ball-park/seating/sections/23 , /3 , /119 , /146 , /403
discovery.known_obstructions: 1) PROTECTIVE NETTING - the Reds' official netting page lists netting in front of sections 1-5, 22-25 and 111-135, with height and coverage varying by section; RateYourSeats fan reports describe netting/screening in front of sections 113-133 extending toward the outfield. 2) FOUL POLES - sections 107 (third-base corner) and 139 (first-base corner) have the foul poles in the sightline; higher rows are less affected. 3) SECTION 108 'knee-knocker' seats - specific angled row/seat combinations to avoid. 4) 400-LEVEL FRONT ROWS - a clear glass partition fronts the first rows; not view-blocking but some fans find it intrusive. 5) KROGER BLEACHERS 401-406 - the main videoboard sits directly overhead and is very hard to see from these seats; similarly 500-level sections 509-519 on the third-base side need a head turn to see the left-field board. 6) UPPER-DECK OVERHANG - back rows of the 100 level (roughly EE and above) are covered, which gives shade but cuts off high fly balls and the videoboards. 7) 'THE GAP' - the 35-ft break in the stands between home plate and third base removes seating entirely there rather than obstructing it. 8) SUN - 100-level outfield sections 101-106 stare into the setting sun even for early evening games, and right field 140-146 gets the most afternoon sun. CONFIRMED: https://mlb.com/reds/ballpark/netting , https://thestadiuminsiders.com/stadium_guides/cincinnati-reds/ticketing-seating-premium/ , https://www.rateyourseats.com/great-american-ball-park/seating/sections/119 , /403
